arguments.summary: A critical APT activity was detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to APT-41 (Double Dragon). The initial compromise occurred via a phishing email triggering an encoded PowerShell execution from Outlook, leading to the deployment of a ShadowPad variant. The malware established C2 communication over HTTPS to a known malicious infrastructure and attempted lateral movement via SMB. Host-based indicators include the use of rundll32.exe from the Temp directory and modification of the hosts file.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Launch from Office Application
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\outlook.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '-enc'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566.001/
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative scripts (rare)
author: SOC Team

rule ShadowPad_APT41_2026 {
    meta:
        description = "Detects ShadowPad variant used by APT-41 with specific mutex"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel"
        date = "2026-04-09"
        hash = "f0e1d2c3b4a5f6e7d8c9b0a1f2e3d4c5b6a7f8e9d0c1b2a3f4e5d6c7b8a9f0e1"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $mutex = "Global\\APT41_ShadowPad_2026" fullword ascii
        $c2_domain = "update.ns3.ezdns.cc" fullword ascii
        $pbd_chinese = "\\\u6d4b\u8bd5" wide
    condition:
        $mutex or $c2_domain or $pbd_chinese
}
